result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text is truncated in restaurant cards.

issues.description: The delivery fee text in the 'Fastest near you' restaurant cards (e.g., '€0.90 delivery', '€2.40 delivery') is clipped on the right side, cutting off the end of the word 'delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card width, reduce the font size, or allow the text to wrap to a second line so the full delivery fee information is visible.
